description: Use this when the user asks for day length differences and average change per day between two local dates, or the solstices and equinoxes of a year. Returns daylight duration for each date and signed changes. Limits: cities with population 50,000+ (plus Tromso), dates/years 1900–2100, flat sea-level horizon; use either date_a and date_b or year, and not both. Does not forecast weather.

city.description: City name, for example New York. Cities with population 50,000+ are supported; the largest same-name match is used.

country.description: Optional country name or two-letter code to narrow the match, for example US.

date_a.description: First local date for a two-date comparison, for example 2026-03-20. Required with date_b; omit with year.

date_b.description: Second local date, for example 2026-06-21. Required with date_a; omit with year.

state.description: Optional US state name or abbreviation, for example NY or New York.

year.description: Year whose equinox and solstice local dates to compare, for example 2026. Omit date_a/date_b.

name: compare_day_length
title: Compare day length
